model.trained_on: Bangladesh: RiceLeafDiseaseBD v3 (Gazipur), BD5 (Savar), KYAU/raihan (Sirajganj-Pabna), Dhan-Shomadhan, DIU field close-ups (half A); India: Paddy Doctor, Sethy; Taiwan. Plus non-rice photos.

external.name: RiceLeafBD real-field photos, Sylhet-Dhaka (Mendeley), never used for training or tuning
external.method: 3 Nov 2026, read once (v10 and the live v8 together): exact duplicates removed (1,446 photos). Same app preprocessing and rule. Bacterial leaf blight counts as 'other rice problem'. See model/experiments/run10_v10/SYLHET_RESULT.md.

external.name: Rice Leaf Disease Classification BD (Aman 2025, Hugging Face Project-AgML), 422 photos with no copy in other datasets
external.method: 3 Nov 2026, read once for v10: only images with no pHash match within 8 bits in any other dataset. Same app preprocessing and rule. See model/experiments/run10_v10/GATE_RESULT.md.

external.name: DIU Rice Leaf Disease and Pest Dataset, Bangladesh (half B, never used for training or tuning)
external.method: 3 Nov 2026, read once for v10: app preprocessing (EXIF upright, Resize 366 + CenterCrop 320) and the app's full decision rule. Close-ups of single leaves on white. Classes outside the app's six count as 'other rice problem'. Version 10 trained on the other half (A) of this dataset; near-copies of half-B photos were removed from training. See model/experiments/run10_v10/GATE_RESULT.md.

limitations: No independent test covers sheath blight or leaf smut. Leaf smut is never named by the app (one field source only).
Tungro and brown spot are often missed on new photos: tungro recall 50% on the DIU test and 33% on the Sylhet test; brown spot recall 32% on Sylhet.
On the Sylhet-Dhaka test (a district never trained on) only 56% of answers are right, and bacterial leaf blight (not covered) is kept from being named as a disease only 36% of the time.

Version 10 was trained on one half of the DIU dataset and tested on the other half (near-copies removed), so the DIU result shows what happens with photos like the training ones, not with every field.

Version 10 was released by the project owner's decision although it failed two pre-written release conditions: on the Aman test its macro-F1 is 2.25 points lower than version 8 (limit 2 points), and on the Sylhet test it ties version 8 and answers fewer photos. It gives fewer wrong answers than version 8 on all three independent tests.
Disease text is preliminary and has not been reviewed by an agronomist.
